title: Detent Engage — promotional cut
reader: A CRO or founder who has considered an AI assistant on their website and decided against it.
reaction: Someone finally built the version I could put my name to.

beats.big:
Your website's AI assistant
will say anything.
beats.small: That is why you have not got one.

beats.lower: It will invent a price. Promise a date you cannot hit.

beats.big:
So we built one
that is not allowed to.

beats.lower: Discloses that it is AI. Before the first question. Every session.
Cannot try to identify a visitor until they say yes. Not degraded. Refused.
Answers only from your own approved knowledge. It cannot make anything up.
Every act in a hash-chained record you can hand to an auditor.
You are charged for the confirmed outcome. Not seats. Not messages.

beats.small: An assistant you can put your name to.
